assumptions.risk_free: Goyal-Welch Rfree. The paper says 'excess returns' and never names the rate.
assumptions.index: CRSP_SPvw, with dividends. Never stated; the 12.65% buy-and-hold AV is unreachable without them.
assumptions.returns: simple, not log. Never stated; the momentum appendix compounds (1+r) and the portfolio arithmetic only closes under simple.
assumptions.sharpe: monthly excess mean over monthly total sd. Never stated; recovered from buy-and-hold's printed 0.17.
assumptions.mdd: a fraction. The table note says percent and every value contradicts it.
assumptions.oos_start: June 1981. p.22's counts give 487 months from June; p.31 says May 1981, which would be 488.
assumptions.cost_timing: W(1+r)(1-c) on a switch, as printed, so the cost lands after the month's return rather than at the trade.
assumptions.metrics_gross: AV, SD, SR and MDD are computed on the portfolio return before costs; costs enter TW only. Not stated, and the notation puts (1-c) in the wealth recursion alone.
assumptions.cer_annualised: monthly CER gain x 12 for both preference types. The paper says 'we annualize' and never says how.
assumptions.mc_nodes: deterministic 4096-node midpoint grid for the integral in eq. (15), not random draws. The paper never states a draw count, and a seeded RNG would make every number depend on a choice the paper did not make.

not_built.GARCH-M model: The paper estimates it in R by QML and never writes the forecast equation; whether the mean carries sigma or sigma-squared rests on one orphaned subscript.
not_built.MS model: Estimated with the R package MSwM. The paper gives no forecast formula and does not say whether filtered or smoothed regime probabilities are used.
